positions.name: GateProtocolSpecBlock
positions.frame: Are these lines functioning as a single ratified specification block (rule, scope, ownership) issued together, rather than as separate narrated claims?
positions.why: Three dimensional passes independently converge on exactly this span: register reads all three as one 'ProtocolSpecRegister' (bolded label-colon-value performing a spec, not narration or argument); relational reads them as one 'GateMandateWithNamedOwner' move (mandate imposed, jurisdiction extended, accountability assigned); style reads them as one 'LabelFrontedRuleFragment' cadence run (bolded keyword plus compressed rule, three times in sequence). Conviction places all three in 'decision' — ratification, not argument. Taken together the three lines cohere as one structured specification act: what the gate is, where it applies, who owns it — issued as a unit distinct from the surrounding prose narration (src-1, src-2), which states and justifies the same underlying rule but in narrative rather than spec form.
